label: Bible Study
prompt: For a _____ years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
verse: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
note: From the only psalm credited to Moses — Peter echoes it: a day as a thousand years.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the _____ of salvation.
verse: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
note: Drawing water with joy from the wells of salvation — a bucket that never comes up empty.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of _____.
verse: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.
note: One man wouldn't bow, and Haman was full of wrath — pride can't stand a single holdout.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And five of you shall _____ an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verse: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
note: The covenant blessing for obedience: five chasing a hundred, a hundred routing ten thousand.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy _____.
verse: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.
note: Daniel's counsel to a proud king: break off your sins by showing mercy to the poor, and perhaps your 'tranquillity' will last.
